review.policy: Do not transfer benchmark content to an automatic external grader. Record structured human or agent review separately against full captured turns; agents cannot certify passes.

measurement.transport: POST /llm/chat with a fresh requested session id per journey
completion_requires: every turn returns a non-empty answer
every turn returns the requested session id
every turn identifies the same model
measurement.semantic_failure_policy: missing, incomplete, or invalid review is an evaluation error and never a quality pass
